details: You try and gather your thoughts as the dust settles across the chamber. You go over the events that just transpired and still cannot comprehend the gravity of the situation.
The Grand Crusader of the Scarlet Crusade a demon? And not just any demon but brother to Varimathras, arch lord of the Undercity?
You carefully stow the severed head of the dreadlord into your pack. Surely, none would believe the tale you would tell without proof.
Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff must be told at once!
completion: What will this mean to the Crusade? Could it be possible that they have been under the control of this demon? Unwittingly serving as the pawns to a greater evil?

5382.name: Doctor Theolen Krastinov, the Butcher
desc: Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to Eva Sarkhoff when the task is complete.
objectives: Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to Eva Sarkhoff when the task is complete.$B
details: Krastinov is responsible for the deaths of thousands. He must be punished, justice must be meted out.
Find him and exact upon him the agony he has inflicted upon countless innocents. Once he is destroyed, burn our remains. Turn them to ashes, $N.
completion: I can feel my spirit healing, $N. You have done my husband and I a great service, but I am certain there is more to be done.

5502.name: A Warden of the Horde
desc: Return your ward to the Orgrimmar orphanage by handing in the Orcish Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Battlewail in the Valley of Honor.
objectives: Return your ward to the Orgrimmar orphanage by handing in the Orcish Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Battlewail in the Valley of Honor.
details: You have been so very kind to me, $N. I never dreamed that I'd have so much fun during Children's Week. Thank you. I won't be sad about what's happened to me - my parents always told me to rise above anything bad that happens. I'll be a hero... just like you.
I'm sad to say this, but it's time for me to go home. Let's go back and I'll tell the matron what an awesome person you are!
completion: May the spirits bless you, $N. You've done more for Grunth than most would ever think of doing for him. Thank you - you're the epitome of what it means to be a hero of the Horde.
Please - if you can spare the time, come back and visit us. I know that Grunth would like that, as would I.

5526.name: Shards of the Felvine
desc: Find the Felvine in Dire Maul and acquire a shard from it. Chances are you'll only be able to procure one with the demise of Alzzin the Wildshaper. Use the Reliquary of Purity to securely seal the shard inside, and return it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.
objectives: Find the Felvine in Dire Maul and acquire a shard from it. Chances are you'll only be able to procure one with the demise of Alzzin the Wildshaper. Use the Reliquary of Purity to securely seal the shard inside, and return it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.
details: Your knowledge of Eldre'Thalas - Dire Maul - in Feralas will now come into play, $N. In the eastern part of the ruined city is where Alzzin the Wildshaper has exerted his corrupt dominion. Go there with all due haste and brave whatever challenges await you.
The Fruit of Fertility, now corrupted as the Felvine, should be close to Alzzin. When he falls, capture whatever essence of the Felvine you can. Seal it in the Reliquary, and bring it to me.
Good luck, and Cenarion's speed.
completion: It is done, brave $C, and with that the Cenarion Circle is in your debt. Though the war is far from over, a great battle has been won against those who would bring about our doom.
Please - accept this as a token of our enduring gratitude. Know that you are welcomed here as a hero of the Cenarion Circle for your great deed, $N. Thank you.

5622.name: In Favor of Elune
desc: Speak to Laurna Morninglight in Teldrassil.
objectives: Speak to Laurna Morninglight in Teldrassil.
details: $N, you must travel to Dolanaar when your business here in Shadowglen is done. There, you will find Laurna Morninglight. She will instruct you further in the ways of Elune, and it is with her that you will earn your first garments denoting your station as a $gpriest:priestess; of Elune.
Take care, and may you be protected in your journeys.
completion: I'm happy to see Shanda has sent you to find me, $N. Teaching young priests the ways of Elune gives me great satisfaction.

5646.name: Devouring Plague
desc: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.
objectives: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.
details: Aelthalyste show our people great respect by sending them back to me for more training, and now I do the same for her tribe.
You return to the Undercity, $N. There, in the War Quarter, she be ready to teach you more 'bout your people and their ways. Go there, and do not wait long.
completion: Good, you've returned, and not a moment too late. We have great things to discuss, $N. Your abilities are growing stronger, and we must make sure you are ready.

5742.name: Redemption
desc: Listen to what Tirion Fordring has to say.
objectives: Listen to what Tirion Fordring has to say.
details: You have worked hard, friend. Rest your weary bones and allow me to properly introduce myself.$B
completion: The Fordring redemption will be a difficult task. Are you prepared?

5862.name: Scarlet Subterfuge
desc: Speak to Myranda to gain the Scarlet Illusion. Travel to Hearthglen while under the Scarlet Illusion and deliver Tirion's Gift to Highlord Taelan Fordring.
Hearthglen is to the north, Taelan should be inside of Mardenholde Keep.
objectives: Speak to Myranda to gain the Scarlet Illusion. Travel to Hearthglen while under the Scarlet Illusion and deliver Tirion's Gift to Highlord Taelan Fordring.
Hearthglen is to the north, Taelan should be inside of Mardenholde Keep.
details: I am what you would call, an illusionist. Though I may be able to create an illusion to allow you entry into Hearthglen, be warned; my powers have their limitations.

Should you travel too far from these lands, the effects of the illusion will cease. The spell itself takes a great amount of concentration and power from me, and thus, I can only sustain the effect for a short time.
Speak to me again when you are ready.
completion: What is this, soldier?
B<Taelan opens the box and begins to examine its contents.>
This... this cannot be true. But all that you have shown me...
B<Taelan falls to one knee, his heartbeat quickens. The fury of ages is about to be loosed upon this town.>

5886.name: Salve via Disenchanting
objectives: {'type': 'item', 'id': 11174, 'target': 'Lesser Nether Essence', 'text': None}
completion: Here are some Cenarion plant salves - I only need one lesser nether essence for this, $n. Essence is by far the most potent item I can make use of to turn swords into plowshares, as it were. If you need more salve, then find me here!

6030.name: Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff
desc: Deliver the book, "Studies in Spirit Speaking", to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.
objectives: Deliver the book, "Studies in Spirit Speaking", to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.
details: A recluse medium found in these parts by the name of Umbranse has provided the Argent Dawn with quite a literary masterpiece... one that amounts to quite possibly the largest collection of jibber-jabber I've ever seen written.

One of the Dawn's most respected leaders, Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff, is a brilliant linguist. Could you take this to him for me - for a reward, of course? Light's Hope Chapel - that's where he's currently at, far in the eastern part of the Eastern Plaguelands.
completion: This... this is a very special book you have brought me. I'd like to tell you that "special" in this case means "unique and quite possibly illuminating", but that remains to be seen.
B"Ooooooo?" Who in their right mind thinks this up?

Well now, I've heard of this Umbranse that Gregor spoke of, so this isn't without merit. I'll do my best to decipher it. As for you... please, have this - courtesy of the Argent Dawn. While you are here, perhaps there are some other things you can aid us with.

6102.name: Taming the Beast
desc: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Strigid Screecher. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Dazalar in Dolanaar.
objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Strigid Screecher. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Dazalar in Dolanaar.
details: You have tamed two creatures that inhabit the land, now you must tame one that soars the skies. Use the taming rod to tame a strigid screecher, found west of here. Practice your skills with this mighty owl at your side.

When you return, I will bestow you with the skills you will need to tame an animal of your choosing to be your companion; this creature will face the challenges you face, and gain experience alongside you. I will also show you how to call it and dismiss it as you wish.
completion: You have learned all I can teach you, $N. May I offer you one more piece of advice: use discretion when choosing your first pet. Will you choose a creature of the land, of the water, or of the sky? Whatever it may be, without doubt, your pet will be with you for quite some time.
Here you are, $N. I will now give you the power to tame a beast, as well as call it and dismiss it as you see fit. Use your new skills with pride; you have earned them.

6126.name: Lessons Anew
desc: Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.
objectives: Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.
details: You're now ready to learn about poison and the power we as druids have over it, $N. Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to purge even the most foul of poisons with but a mere incantation. This gift is not to be taken lightly... and to ensure you learn this lesson, you'll work to address the effects of poisonings as a layman would.
Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze; he awaits your arrival to begin your lesson.
completion: Greetings young druid, I'm glad to see you ready and eager to learn about the curing of poisons.

While most druids in the past were put through pre-planned trials, your work will involve no such thing. There has been a rash of animal poisonings at the Crossroads in the Barrens, and they're unable to bring it under control. Someone there has requested Moonglade for aid, so we are sending you there to aid them. This is no exercise - the work you'll do is quite real. Bear this in mind.

6342.name: Flight to Auberdine
desc: Ride a hippogryph to Auberdine from the hippogryph master Vesprystus, then bring Nessa's Collection to Laird.
objectives: Ride a hippogryph to Auberdine from the hippogryph master Vesprystus, then bring Nessa's Collection to Laird.
details: From Rut'theran, there are two methods of travel to Auberdine: by ferry and by hippogryph. Both are quick and reliable, but if you have not yet flown to Auberdine by hippogryph, then I suggest you do.
It is sound advice to speak with the hippogryph master in every town that has one. Once you speak to the master, you can then fly there from other towns.
Here is Nessa's collection. Speak with me again when you are ready to fly to Auberdine and deliver Nessa's collection to Laird.
completion: A package from Nessa? Thank you, $N! She told me she would send me samples of the fish caught near Rut'theran village. She thinks they may be very different from the fish caught here...
My! This jawbone is nearly twice the size of the same fish found here. And these scales are as big as a closed fist! Amazing!

6390.name: A Plague Upon Thee
desc: Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.
objectives: Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.
details: You look around the lumber mill for something suitable to open the barrel with. You find a crowbar that looks like it will do the trick.
You set your feet and pray that you'll be able to get out of the mill before the termites get to you.
completion: Thank you, $N. Here, take this coin. I'm sorry it's not more, but try to take some joy in helping destroy the Scarlet Crusade's efforts!

6462.name: Troll Charm
desc: Bring 8 Troll Charms to Mitsuwa at the Zoram'gar Outpost.
objectives: Bring 8 Troll Charms to Mitsuwa at the Zoram'gar Outpost.
details: My kinfolk were traveling here with many sacred troll charms, but the Thistlefur furbolgs attacked and killed them before they reached Zoram'gar! Those vile Furbolgs!
I miss my brothers and sisters who were killed, but we will meet again in the afterlife. However, their troll charms hold great value in this world. It is an outrage that the furbolgs have them!
B$N, you must retrieve the charms! They are in chests in Thistlefur Hold, a cave at the end of Thistlefur Village, north of Astranaar.
completion: You found them! Thank you! Thank you, $N! You do not know how great a thing you have done for me.
BA troll without his charm is like an orc without his battle scars...
Worthless.

6582.name: The Test of Skulls, Scryer
desc: You must find the blue dragonflight drake champion, Scryer, and slay him. Pry his skull from his corpse and return it to Emberstrife.
You know that Scryer can be found in Winterspring.
objectives: You must find the blue dragonflight drake champion, Scryer, and slay him. Pry his skull from his corpse and return it to Emberstrife.
You know that Scryer can be found in Winterspring.
details: We are Deathwing's children, whelp. Our dominance over the lesser Aspects must be enforced.
If you are truly worthy of ascension, the lesser dragonflight will wilt in your presence.
Find their champions and lay waste to them in the name of our Father!
Travel to Winterspring and track down the mighty blue drake, Scryer. Crush him and any of the Blue Flight that stand in your path. Tear out his skull and return it to me.
completion: One of ssseveral complete...

6606.name: A Little Luck
desc: Speak with Witch Doctor Mau'ari in Everlook.
objectives: Speak with Witch Doctor Mau'ari in Everlook.
details: We can always use a little luck, eh? A small advantage is all it takes to turn things in your favor...
I happened to make the acquaintance of a rather eccentric witch doctor some time back. She made me a lucky charm... for a price. Believe me, though, it was well worth it!
Maybe you'd be interested in one of your own? Find Witch Doctor Mau'ari in Everlook. I'm not giving mine up!
completion: Ah, so Harlo be sendin' you? Well, den, who might you be? I s'pose you be wantin' my help?

6822.name: The Molten Core
desc: Kill 1 Fire Lord, 1 Molten Giant, 1 Ancient Core Hound and 1 Lava Surger, then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.
objectives: Kill 1 Fire Lord, 1 Molten Giant, 1 Ancient Core Hound and 1 Lava Surger, then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.
details: $n, perhaps it is time to give you a real test. Are you ready?
At the bottom of Blackrock Depths is a passage to the Molten Core. This is a stronghold of our enemy, held by the most powerful servants of fire on this world.
Go to the Molten Core, $N. Show me you have the strength and the will to defeat what you find there.
And if you have allies among your people, then rally them. Nothing short of an army can hope to enter the Molten Core and live.
completion: You have done what most of your kind would think impossible. You have faced the beings of the Molten Core, and triumphed!
For so small a creature, you have displayed great resource.
Some day, perhaps we might strike a true allegiance between your kind and the Waterlords.

7062.name: The Reason for the Season
desc: Speak with Historian Karnik at the Explorer's League in Ironforge about the Feast of Winter Veil.
objectives: Speak with Historian Karnik at the Explorer's League in Ironforge about the Feast of Winter Veil.
details: Gifts, treats, presents... bah, I say!

Those goblins pollute the true meaning of this season - the Feast of Winter Veil. This is a time of renewal; the land slumbers under a blanket of snow brought forth by Greatfather Winter, who is NOT the bumbling fool over there in the red suit!

If you're interested in learning what the Feast is all about for yourself, ask Historian Karnik at the Explorer's League. I'm sure he'll be surprised that someone cares about history rather than getting presents.
completion: The Feast of Winter Veil, you say? Alas, in times past it held a more substantial meaning to us dwarves. Nowadays, it seems as though others have turned the legend of Greatfather Winter into something that helps to sell candies and presents.

It's no surprise that Goli is bitter about that sort of change. He and other dwarves like him cling to our past like a banner of war. While I think a little celebration is always good, it is important to remember the origins of the Feast.

7302.name: Fallen Sky Lords
desc: Find out what became of Wing Commander Guse, Wing Commander Jeztor, and Wing Commander Mulverick. Return to Commander Mulfort should you complete your mission.
objectives: Find out what became of Wing Commander Guse, Wing Commander Jeztor, and Wing Commander Mulverick. Return to Commander Mulfort should you complete your mission.
details: Our air support is in shambles, $N. The Wing Commanders were shot down over enemy territory. You must find out what became of them so that we can attempt a rescue!
Guse was last seen flying over the Icewing Bunker. Jeztor's War Rider was spotted near the Stormpike lumber mill. Mulverick... that reckless fool was seen crashing near the Dun'Baldar North Bunker.
That's all the information I have. Move out! Search through the areas thoroughly.
completion: Well done! The information you recovered will be invaluable to our cause.

7494.name: Feathermoon Stronghold
desc: Speak with Latronicus Moonspear at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.
objectives: Speak with Latronicus Moonspear at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.
details: $N! Your aid is needed in Feralas!
An outlaw mage, Lethtendris, has fled to the ancient elven ruins Eldre'thalas, now called Dire Maul. It is believed she has an item of dangerous magical energy which must be recovered.
Latronicus Moonspear requests agents to enter Dire Maul and retrieve the item from Lethtendris.
Serve the Alliance! Seek out Latronicus at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.
completion: Hail, $N. I am pleased to see you, but regret that our meeting is not under more pleasant conditions.
Listen close, for I have a vital task for you...

7638.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
desc: Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District.
objectives: Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District.
details: The time has come, $N, for you to learn about what it will take for you to acquire something you have no doubt waited on for some time... your charger.

Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker here in Stormwind's Cathedral District. It is he who will guide you not only though the legerdemain of a Paladin's most trusted mount, but the tasks before you to acquire one of your own.
I wish you the best in this trial. For the Light, noble $G brother : sister;!
completion: I am glad to see you $N. I know that you have awaited word as to how to acquire your charger, and now that time has come.

You will be surely tested in many different ways, but most importantly in your willingness to rise above numerous obstacles thrust before you. These are not done as a learning exercise - your stature is beyond simple educational tests. You must save your future companion from the clutches of the evil you have spent your life fighting.
Take heed, your time has come!

7734.name: Improved Quality
desc: Bring 10 Rage Scar Yeti Hides to Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.
objectives: Bring 10 Rage Scar Yeti Hides to Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.
details: I have a lead on an even BETTER source of hides, if that's even possible to believe! In the northern parts of Feralas - deep within Rage Scar Hold - are another throng of yetis. They're much tougher than the ones you dealt with before, so if you're up for a bigger challenge you'd best be on your toes!
I would reward you handsomely for a stack of ten of their hides; bring them to me here, and we'll finish our business.
completion: Excellent, excellent! These are going to work out incredibly well - I can already tell that they're going to be much harder when properly cured.
Thanks again for your aid, $N. Here - please take one of my latest creations.

7782.name: The Lord of Blackrock
desc: Venture to the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind City and speak with Field Marshal Afrasiabi.
objectives: Venture to the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind City and speak with Field Marshal Afrasiabi.
details: Go to the Valley of Heroes and speak with Field Marshal Afrasiabi.
completion: <Field Marshal Afrasiabi bows.>
Choose your reward, let the celebration begin!

7830.name: Avenging the Fallen
desc: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill a Razorbeak Skylord and retrieve its Skylord Plume. Return to him once the task is complete.
Markhor mentioned that the Razorbeak Skylord are a rare breed that tend to occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.
objectives: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill a Razorbeak Skylord and retrieve its Skylord Plume. Return to him once the task is complete.
Markhor mentioned that the Razorbeak Skylord are a rare breed that tend to occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.
details: The filth that calls itself Wildhammer trains gryphon to slay troll. Horrible, I know, but worry not, justice will soon be meted out.
For now, I want you to focus on eradicating the elder gryphons of the region. They are known as Skylords.
Slay one and return to me with its plume.
completion: <Markhor examines the plume.>
I wonder how many of our hunters this beast devoured before you brought it to justice.

7926.name: The Darkmoon Faire
desc: Deliver the Free Ticket Voucher to Gelvas Grimgate, located inside the Darkmoon Faire carnival.
objectives: Deliver the Free Ticket Voucher to Gelvas Grimgate, located inside the Darkmoon Faire carnival.
details: The Darkmoon Faire is coming! Be sure to experience all the wonders and excitement of it when it comes to town!
If you act right now, you can redeem this voucher for free prize tickets! Just hand your voucher to Gelvas Grimgate located inside the carnival.
Right now, the Faire is just outside Thunder Bluff, in Mulgore. Don't miss out! Go today!
completion: Welcome to the Darkmoon Faire! This voucher is good for FIVE, yes, FIVE prize tickets!
When you accumulate prize tickets, you'll want to speak to me about redeeming them for valuable prizes. The more tickets you get, the more prizes you can win. Huzzah!

8046.name: The Heathen's Brand
objectives: {'type': 'item', 'id': 19579, 'target': "Heathen's Brand", 'text': None}
completion: Do what you must to defeat our enemies, $c. Even if it means channeling the Light.
B<Jin'rokh shudders.>

8070.name: Paragons of Power: The Confessor's Bindings
desc: Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Sash. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
Al'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
objectives: Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Sash. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
Al'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
details: Shortly after the fall of the Gurubashi, we Zandalar almost succumbed to a final defeat from evil within our own tribe. It was then that the confessors amongst us arose, preserving the tribe by banishing out those who would destroy their own kind. They not only keep us in tune with the spirits, but they also preserve the flesh.
Go forth into Zul'Gurub and witness first hand the depravity of Hakkar and the Gurubashi. Wrest the Paragons of Power that we seek from them; success will be rewarded!
completion: Success! These will go a long way to building up our power against the rise of Hakkar. With your help, we've taken a significant step in ensuring that the Blood God will not destroy us all.
You've earned honor with the tribe today, $N. Take this - the confessor's bindings - as a symbol of our thanks.

8118.name: Vision of Voodress
objectives: {'type': 'item', 'id': 19607, 'target': 'Vision of Voodress', 'text': None}
completion: Take a look at it now, $n. Voodress come in even clearer now, yea? Let the primal power flow through you, mon.

8142.name: Zandalarian Shadow Talisman
objectives: {'type': 'item', 'id': 19614, 'target': 'Zandalarian Shadow Talisman', 'text': None}
completion: There is only one enhancement left that can be placed on the talisman, $c. When the time is right, I shall apply that enhancement.

8166.name: The Battle for Arathi Basin!
desc: Assault the mine, the lumber mill, the blacksmith and the farm, then return to Field Marshal Oslight in Refuge Pointe.
objectives: Assault the mine, the lumber mill, the blacksmith and the farm, then return to Field Marshal Oslight in Refuge Pointe.
details: $N, the battle for Arathi Basin is a battle for resources and territory. Key points in the area must be held and operated in order to supply our forces with much needed raw materials and supplies. I charge you to assault the points farthest from our Arathi Basin base.
Assault the farm, the mine, the lumber mill and the blacksmith when they are controlled by the enemy. Find the enemy's banner and rip it from its flag post!
When you have done this to all four points, return to me.

8190.name: Hoodoo Hex
desc: Bring me thise things and I will create a powerful enchantment for you!
Primal Hakkari Idol
Punctured Voodoo Doll

8262.name: Arathor Advanced Care Package
completion: You've certainly begun to prove yourself to us, $N. As a reward, please take this care package! Inside it you'll find rations and bandages that are usable only inside Arathi Basin.

As you continue to prove yourself inside the Basin, you'll find that these items will become available to you for purchase. Rations become available when you are Honored with us, and bandages when you are Revered.

8286.name: What Tomorrow Brings
desc: Venture to the Caverns of Time in Tanaris and find Anachronos, Brood of Nozdormu.
objectives: Venture to the Caverns of Time in Tanaris and find Anachronos, Brood of Nozdormu.
details: The embrace of death had all but overcome my being when he intervened. He breathed only once upon my maimed body and then waited patiently for the sands of time to cleanse my wounds.
B"Forever you will remain if you must", he said, and with those words I was bound as a Watcher.

Look now to the desert. The second war is upon us. You must seek out the resting place of the Bronze. Venture to the Caverns of Time and see if the master has returned. I must be sure before I am able to proceed.
completion: It is as it should be - the great one has risen. My watch comes to an end...

8310.name: Breaking the Code
desc: Frankal Stonebridge at Bronzebeard's Encampment in Silithus wants you to recover a Hive'Zora Silithid Brain, Hive'Ashi Silithid Brain, and a Hive'Regal Silithid Brain. Return to Frankal when you have completed this task.
objectives: Frankal Stonebridge at Bronzebeard's Encampment in Silithus wants you to recover a Hive'Zora Silithid Brain, Hive'Ashi Silithid Brain, and a Hive'Regal Silithid Brain. Return to Frankal when you have completed this task.
details: I think I can formulate an elixir that will allow us to more readily decipher the glyphs and language of the silithid and Qiraji! What do I need? Glad you asked! I need brains! More specifically, a brain from each silithid type that inhabit the hives. Bring me brains and Rutgar's work might not be for naught.
completion: Outstanding! Don't wander off too far, kid. We might need you to take on another task or two.

8358.name: Incoming Gumdrop
desc: Do a train emote at Kali Remik, and in exchange you'll receive a Darkspear Gumdrop!

8382.name: Armaments of War
completion: War comes, $N, and with it comes untold horrors. You have done all that could be asked of you and for that you should be rewarded.
Should this... this prophecy ever come to pass...
B<Geologist Larksbane turns pale.>
The future of us all could be at an end.
These armaments will prove invaluable to your campaign in this desert.

8406.name: Fight for Warsong Gulch
desc: Bring 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.

8430.name: Battle of Warsong Gulch
desc: Bring 3 Warsong Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
objectives: Bring 3 Warsong Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
details: The battle in Warsong Gulch against the Silverwing Sentinels is of great importance. Under the guise of protecting a forest that doesn't belong to them, the Alliance seeks to deny the Horde one of our largest sources for lumber.
Do not let this happen, $N! Come back to me with proof of serving the Horde in a worthy manner!
completion: Excellent! You've shown your worth by defending our operations in Warsong Gulch! May word of your honor spread far and wide across our lands.

8502.name: Target: Hive'Ashi Workers
desc: Slay 30 Hive'Ashi Workers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing III in order to complete this quest.

8526.name: The Alliance Needs Roast Raptor!
desc: Bring 20 Roast Raptor to Sarah Sadwhistle at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
objectives: Bring 20 Roast Raptor to Sarah Sadwhistle at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
details: Oh, how's it going, $c? I see that you're interested in maybe gathering up food for the coming war at Ahn'Qiraj? Somehow my dad thought that it would be a good learning experience for me if I were to volunteer to help out here. Big mistake. I don't even like to eat meat.
Anyway, if you feel like it, you could bring me back a lot of roast raptor. Apparently that's what all of the soldiers are going to want.
completion: Gee, that's swell. Thanks for bringing me all of this burnt animal flesh, $C. I'll just put it onto the pile over there. I'm sure that someone will take care of it. I suppose if you have some time on your hands that you might want to bring me more?

8550.name: The Horde Needs Peacebloom!
desc: Bring 20 Peacebloom to Herbalist Proudfeather at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.

8574.name: Stalwart's Battlegear
desc: Bring 15 Cenarion Combat Badges, 20 Cenarion Logistics Badges, 17 Cenarion Tactical Badges and 1 Mark of Remulos to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also attain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest.

8598.name: rAnS0m
desc: Return the Ransom Letter to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.
objectives: Return the Ransom Letter to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.$B
details: <The text on this note is made up of various typefaces glued onto the parchment's surface.>
We've got your precious book, gnome. If you ever want to see it again, you'll do exactly as we ask.
B<A detailed set of instructions is listed, spanning 3 pages.>
Bring the money and come alone!
completion: <Narain's face glows a bright red.>
Booknap my... book, will they!? I'll teach them what it means to mess with a psychic gnome!

8622.name: Stormcaller's Hauberk
desc: Bring the Carapace of the Old God, 2 Idols of the Sage, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

8646.name: Hammershout the Elder
completion: It is good to know the people of this land still pay homage to the olden races. I bid you well, $N, and offer you this token...

8670.name: Runetotem the Elder
completion: Your spirit burns with life, young $C. I accept the homage you pay, and offer in return this token...

8694.name: Shroud of Unspoken Names
desc: Bring 1 Qiraji Regal Drape, 2 Amber Idols, 5 Ivory Scarabs and 5 Bronze Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in Silithus. You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Regal Drape, 2 Amber Idols, 5 Ivory Scarabs and 5 Bronze Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in Silithus. You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
details: I'm glad to hear you're aiding us in our attack on Ahn'Qiraj, $N. I can make you a protective item that'll be of assistance in the fight against our enemy, $c.
I shall need a Qiraji drape, which I'll resize for you of course. I'll also need idols and scarabs which I'll use to create a suitable clasp.
I promise you won't be disappointed.
completion: Ah yes... this drape is immaculate.
Take this cloak, $N. May it protect you from the foul magic of the Qiraji.

8718.name: Bladeswift the Elder
completion: The heavens, in their countless stars, hold answers to earthly mysteries, $N. Might, then, the wise, and the lucky, gaze up and find truth?

8742.name: The Might of Kalimdor
details: A thousand years has passed and just as it was fated, one stands before me. One who shall lead their people to a new age.
The Old God trembles, $N. Oh yes, it fears your faith. Shatter the prophecy of C'Thun.
It knows you come, champion - and with you comes the might of Kalimdor. You have only to let me know when you are prepared and I shall grant you The Scepter of the Shifting Sands.
completion: The Scepter of the Shifting Sands is whole once more, $N.

It must be you who uses the scepter. It must be you who heralds the next age of your people. You must wait for the armies of the Horde and the Alliance to arrive in Silithus before you may ring the Scarab Gong.

8766.name: The Changing of Paths - Conqueror No More

8790.name: Imperial Qiraji Regalia
desc: Merithra of the Dream in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj will create Elementium Infused Armaments for you should you bring her Imperial Qiraji Regalia and 3 Elementium Ore.

8862.name: Elune's Candle
objectives: {'type': 'item', 'id': 21100, 'target': 'Coin of Ancestry', 'text': None}
completion: Very well then - I accept these coins of ancestry. Please take Elune's candle with my blessing. Also, please enjoy these complimentary fireworks.
May your Lunar Festival be joyous and filled with merriment, $N.
And if you choose to face Omen and his minions, you will find Elune's candle quite useful...

8910.name: An Earnest Proposition
desc: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Shadowcraft Bracers to Deliana in Ironforge.
objectives: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Shadowcraft Bracers to Deliana in Ironforge.$B
details: Well met, $c. I've something that might interest you.

I have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality. I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor.

The blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment. Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold. You shall find the effort worth your while.
completion: Excellent! Let's perform the trade then. It's hard to part with this excellent armor, but I'm afraid I won't be needing it any time soon.
If you're interested in performing more work for me, I might be willing to give up the rest of the pieces.

8934.name: Just Compensation
desc: Bring a Devout Belt and a set of Devout Gloves to Deliana in Ironforge.
objectives: Bring a Devout Belt and a set of Devout Gloves to Deliana in Ironforge.
details: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux. I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin. Bring me the belt and set of gloves that you wish to upgrade. I promise the ones I give you in return will be far superior.
completion: You've kept your end of the bargain, I shall keep mine.
Just remember that I'm holding on to the best pieces until your work is finished.

8958.name: Anthion's Parting Words
desc: Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Dreadmist Sandals, Dreadmist Leggings and Dreadmist Mantle.
objectives: Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Dreadmist Sandals, Dreadmist Leggings and Dreadmist Mantle.
details: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.

The only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together. Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to her about any rewards you've arranged for.
I, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
completion: I can't believe our lives are all but forfeit all because of a stupid medallion! And you're sure Anthion mentioned Bodley?
Well, you've done your job so let's get your reward out of the way.

8982.name: Tracing the Source
desc: Speak with Innkeeper Norman in the Undercity.
objectives: Speak with Innkeeper Norman in the Undercity.
details: We must find who the supplier is. I noticed Apothecary Katrina with a bottle of the perfume tucked in her pack. She told me that she purchased it from Norman, the innkeeper.
completion: Ah yes, I just recently received stock of the perfume and cologne. I don't know how long I can keep it on the shelves - seems like no one can get enough of it.
If you ask me, I don't see what the big deal is.

9006.name: Saving the Best for Last
desc: Give Deliana your Helm of Valor and Breastplate of Valor.
objectives: Give Deliana your Helm of Valor and Breastplate of Valor.
details: That's an amazing story, $N! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved. Now maybe I'll be able to sleep at night with both eyes shut.
As to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you'll really enjoy.
completion: I'm going to miss you, $N. I owe you such a debt of gratitude; I think I'll never be able to repay it.
I hope that you enjoy your new head and chest armor, and that it protects you for a long time to come.

9054.name: Cryptstalker Tunic
desc: Huntsman Leopold at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Cryptstalker Tunic if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Tunic, 25 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 4 Arcanite Bars and 3 Cured Rugged Hides.

9078.name: Bonescythe Legplates
desc: Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Bonescythe Legplates if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Legplates, 20 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar, 8 Cured Rugged Hides and 100 gold pieces.

9102.name: Frostfire Bindings
desc: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Frostfire Bindings if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Bindings, 6 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 1 Arcane Crystal and 1 Nexus Crystal.

9126.name: Bonescythe Digs
desc: Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Bone Fragments.
objectives: Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Bone Fragments.$B
details: Don Julio's Bonescythe armor pattern requires bone fragments - a lot of bone fragments. While those crazy enough to venture into Naxxramas provide me with enough of the core materials to make the armor, I'm always looking for more Scourge bone fragments.
So what do you think? Interested in getting your hands dirty and destroying some Scourge at the same time? It's a win-win situation.
completion: You work fast, $N. Fast like a fox... Say, have I ever told you about the time I was in a barber shop quartet?
Remind me to tell you that story one of these days.

9198.name: Craftsman's Writ - Thorium Tube
desc: Deliver 14 Thorium Tubes and the Craftsman's Writ - Thorium Tube - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

9222.name: Epic Armaments of Battle - Friend of the Dawn
desc: For 110 Insignias of the Dawn and 110 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.

9246.name: Icy Scale Breastplate
desc: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 8 Frozen Runes, 24 Heavy Scorpid Scale, 7 Essence of Water, 5 Cured Rugged Hides and 300 gold. You must also be of Exalted reputation with the Argent Dawn.
objectives: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 8 Frozen Runes, 24 Heavy Scorpid Scale, 7 Essence of Water, 5 Cured Rugged Hides and 300 gold. You must also be of Exalted reputation with the Argent Dawn.
details: Thanks to you and Omarion (May he rest in peace), I am now able to create an Icy Scale breastplate. All you need to do is bring me the materials and pay a small crafting fee.
completion: Here is your order, $N. Delivered as promised!

9270.name: Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian
desc: Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris wants you to take Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian to Stratholme and use it on Consecrated Earth. Defeat the entity that is exorcised from the staff and return to him.
objectives: Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris wants you to take Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian to Stratholme and use it on Consecrated Earth. Defeat the entity that is exorcised from the staff and return to him.
details: This final task will be the most difficult of all, $N. You have faced and defeated both an Old God and the Lich King's General, but now you must face the hand of Sargeras.

Take the staff to Stratholme. It is there that you will find a piece of consecrated earth: ground where the greatest knights of Lordaeron were murdered. Place the befouled staff upon the holy ground and prepare for an entity of immense power to break from within... Defeat the demonic being that controls the staff and return to me.

92454.name: Welcome!
details: Welcome to the World of Warcraft!

As special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Dalia Windbreeze in Thendal Grove. You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.
Thanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!
objectives: Bring the Thendal Grove Gift Voucher to Dalia Windbreeze.
*Thendal Grove Gift Voucher (provided)
completion: You are indeed a special hero, <name>. We welcome you to the world of Azeroth, and offer you one of these unique gifts!
progress: Greetings! It is a pleasure to meet you!
I see you have a special voucher. Give it to me and I will offer you something in exchange.

objectives: Use your Skysight racial ability at the Elemental Convergence in Thendal Grove.
* Use your Skysight near the Elemental Convergence
details: As a Windshaper, you have the ability to use the sacred skysight gifted to us by the elemental spirits. Travel to the standing stones to the northeast of the village. Find the elemental convergence there and use your gift.

You'll find that you may draw upon the skysight anywhere, but its boon is much more powerful if you do so in the presence of an elemental convergence. You may at times receive other bits of wisdom from the spirits that are drawn to such places of power, as well.
progress: The gift of skysight will provide you a powerful boon. Use it wisely.

objectives: Use the Well Water Sample Kit to collect samples from the wells at the Jansen Stead and the Molsen Farm.
* Jansen Stead Water Sample
* Molsen Farm Water Sample
* Well Water Sample Kit (provided)
details: We must determine the source and nature of the poison corrupting this land. Let us begin with the groundwater under the farms in the area.
Go to the Jansen Stead and the Molsen Farm, and collect samples from the wells there.

objectives: Kill a Highland Horror within Excavation Sites and bring its root core to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the Wetlands.
* Horrible Rootcore
details: These brackish wetlands hold a greater well of unsalted southern waters. It pains me, yet within my roots I sense a corruption seeping through that mountain gully.
The creatures, like those in our lowlands, react more bitterly to the taint. Lacking the sea's hardening salt since life's dawn, they have little strength against such evil.
Go to those highlands, and bring me the Highland Horror's root core.
progress: These waters harbor unique life in a brine that gives and takes equally.

96390.name: Nip 'Em in the Bud
details: Dark Iron spies have infiltrated Dun Morogh. To what end I canna' not sure, but this is a problem we need to nip in the bud before it is allowed to grow.
Head eastward to Ironband's Compound and kill the Dark Iron spies that you find there.
objectives: Slay 10 Dark Iron Spies in .
* Dark Iron Spy slain (10)
completion: These Dark Irons may be our cousins but they ain't family, that's for sure. I shed no tears for any misfortune that befalls them that stray too far from that accursed mountain o' theirs.
Hopefully this is enough to put 'em off of further incursions into these lands.

objectives: Bring the journal to Lyreena Duskblade near Dolanaar.
*Lost Journal (item) (provided)
details: <The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.
There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>

objectives: Collect the Raider's Battleaxe, Raider's Bow, and Raider's Shield from the Tiragarde Keep outskirts, then return them to Turroc in Razor Hill.
*Raider's Bow
*Raider's Battleaxe
*Raider's Shield (Forever)
details: We lost many brave warriors of the Horde when we sacked Tiragarde Keep. Now that the humans have reinforced the ruins, we cannot collect their remains to properly honor their deaths.
Go to the ruins surrounding the keep, and search for the weapons left by our fallen kin. We will display them in a place of honor.
progress: Have you done what I asked?

objectives: Return 8 Smooth Boulders to Thra behind Grommash Hold.
*Smooth Boulder (8)
details: Hey! You've got time to help us out! I know you do, I can tell by the way you smiled watching the game we're playing.
This spot behind Grommash Hold is nice because it's clear enough for us to set up our figures. But what stinks is we don't have enough rocks for chairs or tables.
You're big and strong... d'ya think you could carry back some medium-sized rocks, smooth enough to sit on if we need a rest?
progress: It's nice to not have to always sit in the dirt!

objectives: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.
*Menethil Statuette (provided)
details: You'll want to take this to Stormwind right away. Proud as I am that this keep and harbor bears King Terenas Menethil II's name, we are a calm harbor in a very nasty storm of enemies. It's just not safe here.
The Dragonmaw in particular would sacrifice much to loot something like this... and I shudder to think of what they'd do with it.
Don't bother going up the chain of command on this one, . Go straight to Highlord Fordragon with this. He'll know where it will be best kept.
progress: Let us speak, <class>. I can feel you carry something of the Light.
